title: Saving: ignore a damaged save instead of loading it
body:
The storage module already ignores a save that's too old, from another game version, or not valid JSON. A save with valid JSON but missing parts (no level, a level of 0, no seed) still got through, and the game would then start with no puzzle to build.

## What changed
- `js/core/storage.js`: `load()` now also checks the save points at a real puzzle: a game id, a whole-number level from 1, a whole-number puzzle count from 0, and a seed. If not, it's treated like a stale save: removed, and she starts fresh.
- New unit test in `tests/unit/storage.test.js`: each kind of damaged save is dropped and removed, and a normal save still loads.

## How to try it
`node tests/serve.mjs`, open `http://localhost:4173/logic-lane/`, start the demo, press 🏠, then in DevTools change `level` in `logic-lane:resume` to `0` and reload: the home screen shows, and the demo's picker has no Continue.

## Checks
- `js/core/storage.js` stays at 100% line coverage.
- Local `npm run check`: type check passed, 379 unit tests passed, 183 browser tests passed. Visual snapshots skipped locally (they run only on GitHub); no picture should change.
- No decisions changed. No packages added or upgraded.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
why: Logic stays inside the storage module, uses the existing stale-save path (removes only the logic-lane:resume key), keeps the 3-hour and version checks unchanged, and comes with a unit test.
